app.name: Comet Cast
app.tagline: Share your screen, documents, links and files.
app.scanAgainBody: Scan the QR code on the screen once more to continue.

errors.invalid: This is not a valid relay address.
errors.insecure: Unencrypted ws:// is only allowed for localhost and local network addresses. Please use wss://.
errors.credentials: The address must not contain a user name or password.
errors.path: The address must not contain a path, query or fragment (only an optional /ws).
errors.mixed: A page opened over https cannot use an unencrypted ws:// relay (the browser blocks it). Please use wss://.

confirm.title: Use this relay?
confirm.body: A link asks this page to use the relay {host} instead of the default. Only continue if you know and trust its operator.
confirm.risk: The operator of this relay can see who connects, your room codes and network addresses, and can redirect the connection. Nothing is connected and no screen is captured before you decide.

status.negotiating: A sender joined. Setting up the connection…
status.peer_left: The sender left. You can keep this code and wait for a new sender.

transferError.bad_message: A message from the sender could not be understood and was ignored.
transferError.too_large: The image was larger than announced and was discarded.
transferError.size_mismatch: The image arrived incomplete and was discarded.
transferError.no_transfer: An image transfer ended unexpectedly and was ignored.
transferError.stalled: The transfer from the sender stopped and was discarded.
transferError.bad_chunk: Image data arrived in an unexpected form and was discarded.
transferError.image_too_large: The image has too many pixels to be shown and was discarded.
transferError.image_invalid: The image could not be read and was discarded.
transferError.document_unsupported: The sender sent a PDF document. This app cannot show documents yet.
transferError.document_invalid: The PDF is damaged or not supported and cannot be shown.
transferError.document_encrypted: The PDF is password protected and cannot be shown.
transferError.document_too_large: The PDF is too large to be shown.
transferError.document_too_many_pages: The PDF has too many pages to be shown.
transferError.document_rejected: The PDF was refused by the safety check and is not shown.
transferError.document_memory: The PDF needs more memory than allowed and was closed.
transferError.document_timeout: Showing the PDF took too long and it was closed.
transferError.document_failed: The PDF could not be shown.

link.title: {host} wants to open a link
link.hint: The sender asks you to open this link. Open it only if you expect it. It opens in a new tab, and only if you click “Open”.
link.hintTv: This screen cannot open web pages. Open the address on your own device if you need it.

media.hint: This link points to a media file. It is loaded from {host} only if you click “Play”.
media.label: Media player, {host}
media.hlsUnsupported: This looks like an HLS stream, which this browser cannot play. You can still open the link.

error.network: {host} could not be reached or did not answer in time.
error.decode: The file from {host} is damaged or could not be decoded.
error.unsupported: This file cannot be played here: the format is not supported, the file is missing, or the media server does not allow playback from other sites. Use Open to view it in a new tab. ({host})
error.blocked: The browser blocked automatic playback. Click "Try again" to start it.

media.mixed: This address uses http:// but this page uses https://, so the browser would block playing it here. You can still open the link.
media.localWarning: Warning: this address points to a device or a name inside a network (an IP address or a local name). Only play it if you expect that.

announce.replaced: New content replaced the previous one.

pageError.failed: This page could not be shown.
pageError.bad_size: This page has an unusable size.
pageError.timeout: Showing this page took too long.
pageError.memory: This page needs too much memory.

status.idle: Enter the receiver's code to start.
status.capturing: Choose what to share in the browser dialog…
status.peer_left: The receiver left. Sharing has ended.
status.waiting_approval: Waiting for the host to allow you to join. Nothing is sent until then.

errors.bad_hello: The server did not accept the handshake. Please reload the page.
errors.proto_mismatch: This page and the server use different protocol versions. Please reload the page.
errors.wrong_role: This action is not allowed for this role.
errors.room_not_found: No room with this code exists. Check the code on the receiver.
errors.room_full: This room already has a sender.
errors.not_in_room: The other device is not connected anymore.
errors.bad_message: The server could not understand a message. Please reload the page.
errors.altcha_required: The server wants a short browser check before it creates a room. Please try again.
errors.altcha_invalid: The browser check was not accepted (it may have expired). Please try again.
errors.altcha_failed: The browser check could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.altcha_too_hard: The server asked for a browser check that is too demanding for this device, so it was not started. Please try again later or contact the server operator.
errors.altcha_expired: The browser check from the server had already expired. Please try again; if it keeps happening, check that the date and time of this device are correct.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests from this network. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.banned: This network is blocked for a while because of too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
errors.forbidden: This network is not allowed to use this server.
errors.server_full: The server is full right now. Please try again later.
errors.connection_lost: The connection to the server was lost or could not be made.
errors.peer_failed: The direct connection to the other device failed. Without STUN/TURN servers this only works in the same local network.
errors.capture_denied: Screen sharing was cancelled or not allowed.
errors.capture_failed: The screen could not be captured by this browser.
errors.join_pending: Please wait until the host has allowed you to join.
errors.join_denied: The host did not allow you to join.
errors.room_locked: The room code is correct, but the room is locked right now. Ask the host to unlock it.
errors.room_locked_waiting: The room was locked while you were waiting. The code was right; ask the host to unlock it.
errors.approval_timeout: Nobody answered your request in time. You can ask again.
errors.removed_by_host: The host removed you from the room.
errors.open_rooms_disabled: This server does not allow open rooms.
errors.no_such_request: That request is no longer waiting.
errors.no_such_block: That block entry no longer exists.
errors.block_list_full: The block list is full. Unblock somebody first.

toolbar.label: Screen tools
toolbar.freeze: Freeze image (the live stream keeps running)
toolbar.frozenHint: Frozen. The live stream keeps running in the background.

sendContent.title: Send file or link
sendContent.intro: Enter the receiver's room code, then send an image, a PDF or a link. The content travels directly to the receiver; the server only helps to connect.

status.idle: Enter the receiver's code to start.
status.waiting_approval: Waiting for the host to allow you to join.

image.title: Image
image.help: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to {max}.
image.sent: Sent {name}. It is now shown on the receiver.

error.bad_type: Only PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF images can be sent.
error.channel_closed: The connection was closed while sending.
error.busy: Another file is still being sent. Wait until it has arrived.
error.failed: The image could not be sent.

link.title: Link
link.label: Web address
link.hint: Must start with http:// or https://. The receiver sees the address and decides whether to open it; nothing opens automatically. A link to a video or audio file (.mp4, .webm, .ogv, .m3u8, .mp3, .ogg, .wav, .m4a) can be played by the receiver after a click.
link.invalid: Please enter a full web address starting with http:// or https://.
link.sent: Link sent. The receiver has to confirm before it opens.
link.failed: The link could not be sent.

later.title: Coming later
later.note: These need the native core and are not available in the browser version yet.

document.title: PDF document
document.help: A PDF file, up to {max}. The receiver shows it page by page; nothing in the file is run or opened.
document.sent: Sent {name}. The receiver shows it if it can (a file it cannot show gives a notice there).
document.pagesHelp: Turns the page on the receiver.

error.bad_type: Only PDF files can be sent here.
error.not_pdf: This file does not look like a PDF.
error.channel_closed: The connection was closed while sending.
error.busy: Another file is still being sent. Wait until it has arrived.
error.failed: The PDF could not be sent.

welcome.title: Hi! This screen is about to become a display device.
welcome.body: Afterwards anyone in the room can show here what is on their phone or laptop. With a code, no account.

name.title: What is this room called?
name.body: The name is shown large on the screen so people know they are in the right place.

mode.title: Who may connect?
mode.openText: Anyone who sees the code connects at once. For small groups, teams and at home.
mode.approvalText: Each person shows up here as a request and you let them in. For rooms many people use.
mode.later: You can switch or lock any time later in the settings.

address.title: Which address will others use?
address.body: This address is shown large on the screen and is inside the QR code.
address.sourceDefault: Default server. Nothing to set up.
address.sourceOwn: Found via the company network (DNS entry).
address.sourceBox: In-house box found on this network.
address.sourcePage: Set by the server of this page.

done.title: Done.
done.bodyRemote: Open the settings any time with the Menu key or the Settings button: joining and appearance.
done.bodyPointer: Open the settings any time with “Settings” at the bottom right: joining and appearance.

idle.appLine: No download needed. Prefer an app: App Store · Google Play · {dom}/app

offline.title: No connection to {dom}
offline.body: This screen is offline right now. Code and QR code come back by themselves once the network is back.
offline.bodyBusy: The server is busy right now. This screen tries again by itself.
offline.bodyOutdated: This page is out of date. Reload it to get a code.

join.label: Joining
join.openText: Anyone with the code connects at once.
join.approvalText: You let each person in one by one.
join.lockedText: Nobody new can join. Connected stay.

request.title: Request
request.subtitle: wants to connect
request.otherDevice: This name was used here before by a different device.

toast.openDisabled: This server only allows Approval on

start.codeEmpty: Please enter the code shown large on the screen.
start.browserPhone: No install. Show photos, files and links.
start.browserLaptop: No install. Show your screen, a window, files and links.
start.appAndroid: Get the app on Google Play
start.appIos: Get the app on the App Store
start.appPhone: With the app you can also share your whole phone screen.
start.appLaptop: The app finds screens on the same network without a code. For now the browser is enough.
start.beDisplay: Should this device be the screen itself? Open {dom}/display.
start.downloadStarted: Download started. Until the app is installed, everything works here in the browser.

what.title: What would you like to show?
what.screenLaptop: Whole screen or one window, live
what.screenPhoneBrowser: On a phone only with the app
what.fileSub: PDF or image. You turn pages, everything else stays with you
what.linkSub: The screen asks before it opens the page
what.screenPhoneBrowserNoApp: Not possible in a phone browser

file.title: What would you like to show?
file.body: Recent on this device. Or “Other file” in the system dialog.
file.bodyWeb: A PDF or an image from this device. It appears on the screen as soon as you pick it.

link.label: Page address
link.hint: The screen needs its own internet for this.

presenting.sas: Security code {sas}. The screen shows the same code under your name.

presenter.banner: Paused: the audience sees the last picture.
presenter.displayFrozen: The display has frozen the picture.

bye.title: Disconnected
bye.body: You are no longer connected. You can close this tab.

code.title: This code does not exist right now
code.why: Usually a typo. A code has 6 characters and never contains O, 0, I or 1.
code.now: Look at the screen again and retype the code.

expired.title: This code is no longer valid
expired.why: The screen has a new code by now. Codes change when the display device restarts or a session ends.
expired.now: Type the code the screen shows now, or scan the QR code again.

otherServer.title: This code belongs to another address
otherServer.why: You are on {here}. The code fits another server, for example a company’s or a club’s.
otherServer.now: Look at the screen: it shows the right address. Or scan the QR code and both match.

noInternet.title: No internet on this device
noInternet.why: Your device is offline, or the Wi-Fi only allows certain sites.
noInternet.now: Turn on mobile data or join the room’s Wi-Fi. The page then retries by itself.
noInternet.nowBox: For {dom} you must be on the same Wi-Fi as the screen. Ask for the room’s Wi-Fi.

noScreen.title: Screen sharing does not work in this browser
noScreen.why: Phone browsers may not pass on your screen. That is the browser, not you.
noScreen.now: Show a photo, a file or a link instead. Or get the app, then the screen works too.
noScreen.nowNoApp: Show a photo, a file or a link instead.

displayOff.title: The screen does not answer
displayOff.why: The display device is off, asleep, or Comet Cast is closed there. Your request did not arrive.
displayOff.now: Is the code still on the screen? If not, ask the host to open Comet Cast there.
displayOff.whyRelay: The two devices could not reach each other, and the server could not help this time.

denied.title: Not allowed
denied.now: Ask in person if you need to.

locked.title: Locked right now
locked.why: The code is right, but this screen is not taking anyone new right now.
locked.whyWhile: The host locked the room while you were waiting. Your request was dropped.
locked.now: Try again later or talk to the host.

timeout.title: No answer
timeout.why: Nobody answered your request in time.
timeout.now: Ask again and let the host know.

ended.title: Presentation ended
ended.why: The session was ended on the screen.
ended.now: To continue, enter the new code or scan the QR code again.

occupied.title: Someone else is connected
occupied.why: This screen takes one person at a time.
occupied.now: Ask that person to disconnect, or ask the host to press End. Then try again.

busy.title: The server is busy
busy.why: Too many attempts from this network, or too many people at once.
busy.now: Wait a minute, then try again.

outdated.title: This page is out of date
outdated.why: The server was updated in the meantime.

other.title: Something went wrong
other.now: Try again. If it happens again, tell the host.
